# azuredevops-provider-kog — LLM doc index
# A Krateo KOG provider (oasgen-provider 0.55.0) exposing Azure DevOps REST resources as
# azuredevops.krateo.io Kubernetes kinds. The chart ships RestDefinitions + trimmed OpenAPI documents
# only (no image, no plugin). Status: Phase 2a — GitRepository, GitPush, Pipeline, PipelinePermission,
# TeamProject, Environment, Queue, CheckApproval, CheckExclusiveLock, CheckRequiredTemplate, CheckTask
# native and live-verified. OAS documents are generated from Microsoft's spec archived in Software
# Heritage and converted to OpenAPI 3.0.3 (rest-dynamic-controller 0.54.x loads OAS 3 only).
docs/index.md: the map — what the provider is, the kinds by family and phase (Phase 1 done), layout
docs/overview.md: how it works, design decisions, where the OAS documents come from (SWH), conventions, per-kind behaviour table, GitPush recovery, phase plan, upstream dependencies (#491 #499 #502 #503 #490 #323 #496-#498)
docs/usage.md: install on oasgen-provider 0.55.0, the PAT Secret, migration from the classic provider (mutually exclusive) and the legacy KOG chart
docs/configuration.md: chart values, the per-kind <Kind>Configuration, the config chart (values + per-kind verbs/api-version), CI-enforced RestDefinition invariants
docs/api.md: the generated CRDs, version derivation, Phase 1 kinds' spec/status fields
docs/examples.md: index of runnable examples
docs/release.md: one plain-semver tag -> preflight (semver, lint passed, token set) -> both charts to GHCR -> same bytes pulled back -> krateo-blueprints helm index, operators channel
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/dev-cluster/README.md: local kind cluster with oasgen-provider 0.55.0 and the ADO PAT Secret
examples/repository-pipeline/README.md + 1..5-*.yaml: GitRepository -> GitPush x2 -> Pipeline -> PipelinePermission, with delete semantics
README.md: the repo front door
chart/Chart.yaml: chart metadata; version is the CHART_VERSION placeholder
chart/values.yaml: resourceGroup and kinds, with rationale
chart/values.schema.json: the schema the CDC derives the component CRD from
chart/templates/_helpers.tpl: kindEnabled helper (empty kinds = all)
chart/templates/rd-<kind>.yaml + configmap-<kind>.yaml: one RestDefinition + OAS ConfigMap per kind (gitrepository, gitpush, pipeline, pipelinepermission, teamproject, environment, queue, checkapproval, checkexclusivelock, checkrequiredtemplate, checktask); each RD comments its identity, exclusions, compareScope and verb choices
chart/assets/<kind>.yaml: GENERATED OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents (header lists source SWHID and every departure)
config-chart/: azuredevops-provider-kog-config — one <Kind>Configuration per kind from one PAT Secret, per-verb api-version table in templates/configurations.yaml
hack/oas-recipes/<kind>.yaml: source SWHID, kept operations, patches each with a reason
hack/fetch-specs.py: fetch pinned spec blobs from Software Heritage, verify hashes
hack/trim-oas.py: trim + patch + convert Swagger 2.0 -> OpenAPI 3.0.3; --check for CI
hack/render-check.py + render-check-allow.yaml: render via oasgen-render; fail on generation errors, leaked query params, kinds drift, config-chart/CRD mismatch
